notes: Organizational names and published websites only; no contacts or addresses. Source listings do not establish current activity or swimming-team counts. The 51 NFHS member-state associations exclude affiliates and other school authorities. The 59 LSC links retain source-published HTTP and legacy URLs; destination websites and all club directories still require review. Opaque LSC listing keys are derived from source labels, not official LSC codes; never join team affiliations by these keys. No assertion of national directory completeness. The 51 USMS LMSCs extend regional discovery only, with source-provided numeric LMSCIDs and website evidence from the official USMS index. LMSCs are distinct from USA Swimming LSCs. No club, workout-group or facility rows are inferred; no roster or contact pages were fetched. Eleven Canadian starting points (Swimming Canada and its ten provincial sections) extend discovery with two-letter province jurisdictions; provincial membership lists are source assertions, not national counts.
